PICK A DIRECTION

Three stances on the same skeleton: the core loop, influences, mechanics, scale, platforms.

Mechanics are read off the current build, not the README — autofire, the charge-and-release boost, the food chain that refuels it, air time, oxygen, the hive, nine bosses, permadeath. No recoil anywhere.

Every [BRACKET] is a copy slot and the brief inside it names what that line is for. All yours to write. Numbers, platforms and the URL are real.

A — DEPTH COLUMN

The page is the game's cross-section: sky, waterline, five sections sinking to a seabed footer. Inset diagram is the boost loop — hold, strike, eat, full. Eight mechanic cards. Game palette, Space Grotesk + Inter.

For: the layout argues the setting before a word is read, and it holds the most mechanics of the three.

Against: dark and ink-hungry — web and social more than a printed handout.

B — FIELD GUIDE

A naturalist's plate on warm paper. Fig. 1 is the real playfield: air time above the line, oxygen below it, food and the boost meter labelled with leader lines. Eight mechanics, a platform table. Chakra Petch + Nunito.

For: densest and most precise; prints and photocopies clean.

Against: quiet. Rewards someone already leaning in — it won't stop a scroll.

C — CABINET

Arcade poster: 100px Bangers, flat cyan and amber slabs, hex hive motif, the loop as one big glyph. Four mechanics get blocks, four more get a pill row.

For: reads across a room, most personality, fewest words to write.

Against: least complete — half the mechanics are reduced to a name, and influences are just four pills.
